$ python - <<'EOF'
import warnings
import numpy as np
from astropy.table import Table

def read_qdp(text):
    with open('/tmp/v.qdp','w') as f:
        f.write(text)
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
        return Table.read('/tmp/v.qdp', format='ascii.qdp')

# bug-report case
t = read_qdp('read serr 1 2\n1 0.5 1 0.5\n')
err_cols = [c for c in t.colnames if 'err' in c]
assert len(err_cols) == 2, t.colnames
assert t[err_cols[0]][0] == 0.5 and t[err_cols[1]][0] == 0.5

# lowercase TERR + SERR with valid shape
t2 = read_qdp('read terr 1\nread serr 2\n53000.123456 2.378472e-05 -2.378472e-05 -0.212439 0.212439\nNO NO NO NO NO\n')
assert any('_perr' in c for c in t2.colnames) and any('_nerr' in c for c in t2.colnames), t2.colnames

# mixed case
with open('/tmp/v.qdp','w') as f:
    f.write('Read Terr 1\nRead Serr 2\n53000.123456 2.378472e-05 -2.378472e-05 -0.212439 0.212439\n')
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
    t3 = Table.read('/tmp/v.qdp', format='ascii.qdp')
assert any('_perr' in c for c in t3.colnames), t3.colnames

# uppercase regression
t4 = read_qdp('READ SERR 1 2\n1 0.5 1 0.5\n')
assert len([c for c in t4.colnames if 'err' in c]) == 2, t4.colnames

# NO masking untouched
t5 = read_qdp('read serr 1\n1 NO\n')
err = [c for c in t5.colnames if 'err' in c][0]
assert np.ma.is_masked(t5[err][0]) or np.isnan(t5[err][0])
print('repro verification OK')
EOF
